how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-scholomance-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

E39.en: Left Piece of Lord Valthalak's Amulet

rows.quest:5529:obj:0: Kill 20 ⟦E1⟧, then return to ⟦E2⟧ at the ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:5529:details:0: The Argent Dawn recently learned that the Scourge are creating their own plagued dragonflight! We must stop them -- if the Scourge gain a force of dragons they'll sweep across ⟦E5⟧ unchecked!
rows.quest:5529:details:1: Their necromancers are breeding plagued dragons at the ⟦E6⟧, in the middle of Darrowmere Lake.
rows.quest:5529:details:2: Go to the ⟦E6⟧ and kill as many hatchlings as you can... before they get any bigger!
rows.quest:5529:progress:0: Get to the ⟦E6⟧, ⟦1⟧.  Take out those plagued hatchlings before they grow!
rows.quest:5529:completion:0: Well done, ⟦2⟧! It'll be a long time before they can grow another clutch of dragons.
rows.quest:5529:completion:1: B...At least, I hope it will!
rows.quest:4771:obj:0: Place ⟦E7⟧ in the Viewing Room of the ⟦E6⟧. Defeat ⟦E8⟧, then return to ⟦E2⟧.
rows.quest:4771:details:0: I've placed ⟦E7⟧ in the container you brought to us, the one that held the dragon eggs. Your job is to bring it deep within the ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:4771:details:1: The undead mage ⟦E8⟧ leads a team of scourge scholars... place ⟦E7⟧ in their chamber, called the "viewing room." It will then react with the undead found there and, with a little luck, destroy them!
rows.quest:4771:details:2: After that, defeating ⟦E8⟧ shouldn't be a problem. Right?
rows.quest:4771:progress:0: Remember, ⟦3⟧ - we must be tolerant yet rigid in our beliefs!
rows.quest:4771:completion:0: You did it! ⟦E8⟧ is defeated! And ⟦E7⟧... did it work?
rows.quest:4771:completion:1: Hm... maybe my device wasn't the success I had hoped, but I'm glad you were able to handle things anyway. Well done, ⟦4⟧!
rows.quest:4771:completion:2: The Argent Dawn, and the good people of ⟦E5⟧, are in your debt.
rows.quest:5341:obj:0: Venture to the ⟦E6⟧ and recover the ⟦E10⟧ fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: ⟦E11⟧; ⟦E12⟧; ⟦E13⟧; and ⟦E14⟧. Return to ⟦E15⟧ when you have completed this task.
rows.quest:5341:details:0: Within the ⟦E6⟧ lays the ⟦E10⟧ fortune. I, ⟦E15⟧, am one of the last two remaining heirs of the house ⟦E16⟧. My brother, Weldon, is the other.
rows.quest:5341:details:1: Weldon, the miserable coward, fled during the war and thus retained his worthless existence as a human.
rows.quest:5341:details:2: He now searches for the deeds so that he may claim the fortune for his own. Recover the deeds before my brother does and I shall make you wealthy beyond your wildest dreams!
rows.quest:5341:progress:0: ⟦E17⟧ your head in my presence, ⟦5⟧. I am a noble, after all, and you are a copperless peasant.
rows.quest:5341:completion:0: Excellent work, ⟦6⟧. Now to secure my inheritance...
rows.quest:5343:obj:0: Venture to the ⟦E6⟧ and recover the ⟦E10⟧ fortune. Four deeds make up this fortune: ⟦E11⟧; ⟦E12⟧; ⟦E13⟧; and ⟦E14⟧. Return to ⟦E18⟧ when you have completed this task.
rows.quest:5343:details:0: My dear brother Alexi. What a fool I was to spare his life. I looked into the face of the enemy, one of the undead, and let him live.
rows.quest:5343:details:2: He now searches for MY inheritance. This simply cannot happen.
rows.quest:5343:details:3: Find my family's deeds before that vile retch gets his boney hands upon them and I shall reward you with vast riches. They lay in the ruins of the ⟦E6⟧. Make haste!
rows.quest:5343:progress:0: ⟦E17⟧ your head in my presence, ⟦7⟧. I am a noble, after all, and you are a copperless peasant.
rows.quest:5343:completion:0: Excellent work, ⟦8⟧. Now to secure my inheritance...
rows.quest:5382:obj:0: Find ⟦E20⟧ inside the ⟦E6⟧. Destroy him, then burn the Remains of ⟦E21⟧ and the Remains of Lucien Sarkhoff. Return to ⟦E21⟧ when the task is complete.⟦9⟧
rows.quest:5382:details:0: Krastinov is responsible for the deaths of thousands. He must be punished, justice must be meted out.
rows.quest:5382:details:1: Find him and exact upon him the agony he has inflicted upon countless innocents. Once he is destroyed, burn our remains. Turn them to ashes, ⟦10⟧.
rows.quest:5382:completion:0: I can feel my spirit healing, ⟦11⟧. You have done my husband and I a great service, but I am certain there is more to be done.
rows.quest:5384:obj:0: Return to the ⟦E6⟧ with the ⟦E24⟧. Find the porch and place the ⟦E24⟧ in the brazier. Kirtonos will come to feast upon your soul.
rows.quest:5384:obj:1: Fight valiantly, do not give an inch! Destroy Kirtonos and return to ⟦E21⟧.⟦12⟧
rows.quest:5384:details:1: B<Eva points to the vial inside the bag.>
rows.quest:5384:details:2: The blood of innocents. The purest blood, used to appease Krastinov's master.
rows.quest:5384:details:3: It is with this blood that Kirtonos may be summoned. It is with this blood, then, that Kirtonos must be destroyed.
rows.quest:5384:details:4: Take the blood to the porch. Place it upon the brazier. Kirtonos will come - he cannot resist. When he appears, unleash the fury and wrath of a thousand innocent deaths upon him.
rows.quest:5384:details:5: Should you succeed, you will earn more than just our gratitude.
rows.quest:5384:progress:0: Be wary, Kirtonos is a seasoned fighter.
rows.quest:5384:completion:0: With the death of Kirtonos, a chapter in the horrible tale of ⟦E6⟧ comes to a close. There is, however, more to be done. Others here are now aware of your brave acts. Take this, ⟦14⟧. It is a piece of our own essence. It will allow you to communicate with the other lost souls of ⟦E26⟧.
rows.quest:5466:obj:0: Find Ras Frostwhisper in the ⟦E6⟧. When you have found him, use the ⟦E27⟧ on his undead visage. Should you succeed in reverting him to a mortal, strike him down and recover the ⟦E29⟧. Take the head back to ⟦E30⟧.
rows.quest:5466:details:0: There is but one task remaining, ⟦15⟧. Confront the lich, Ras Frostwhisper, in his lair.
rows.quest:5466:details:1: Use the power of the keepsake against the beast - be unrelenting in your actions! Weather the blows that the flailing beast will surely bring down upon you. Do not give in to the pain!
rows.quest:5466:details:2: When the ritual is complete, Ras will be mortal once more. It is at that point that he must be slain. Strike him down and take his human head.
rows.quest:5466:progress:0: You carry the burden of ten thousand restless souls, ⟦16⟧.
rows.quest:5466:completion:0: Ten thousand souls cry out in unison, ⟦17⟧! You have struck a mortal blow to the Scourge and their masters.
rows.quest:5515:obj:0: Locate Jandice ⟦E16⟧ in the ⟦E6⟧ and destroy her. From her corpse recover ⟦E33⟧. Return the bag to ⟦E21⟧.
rows.quest:5515:details:0: A great weight has been lifted from our hearts, ⟦18⟧, but your task is not yet complete. Krastinov's master, Kirtonos, still lives.
rows.quest:5515:details:1: Before you may face Kirtonos, however, you must first secure a method in which to summon him.
rows.quest:5515:details:2: It is said that Jandice ⟦E16⟧ stewards the blood of innocents from Krastinov to Kirtonos.
rows.quest:5515:details:3: Find her in the sunken catacombs of ⟦E6⟧ and strike her down. Bring back any clues that you may find.
rows.quest:5515:progress:0: <Eva fades in and out of focus.>
rows.quest:5531:details:0: The eggs you brought were to be used in Scourge experiments to create a plagued dragonflight. These frozen black dragon eggs would have been invaluable in their studies, and would have assuredly quickened their timetable.
rows.quest:5531:details:1: Now, it is time we ended their research.
rows.quest:5531:details:2: Take the frozen eggs to ⟦E2⟧ outside. She is well-learned in science and alchemy, and has produced a weapon we can use against the Scourge. With your help, we will deal them a heavy blow.
rows.quest:5531:progress:0: Hello, ⟦19⟧! I heard you were here with some dragon eggs? Well, let's see them!
rows.quest:5531:completion:0: There they are! And in such a nice container. The perfect size!
rows.quest:5531:completion:1: We'll keep these eggs in a safe place so we can study them later, but right now we need that thing you brought them in.
rows.quest:5531:completion:2: I have created a device with a very specific use: to destroy the undead scholars of the ⟦E6⟧. They are studying dragons in their efforts to create a plagued dragonflight, and we must halt their progress.
rows.quest:5531:completion:3: I call the device ⟦E7⟧, because... I'm not sure if it works!
rows.quest:5531:completion:4: Will you find out for us?
rows.quest:8969:obj:0: Use the ⟦E35⟧ to summon forth the spirit of ⟦E36⟧ and slay him. ⟦E37⟧ inside ⟦E38⟧ with the ⟦E39⟧ and the ⟦E35⟧.
rows.quest:8969:details:0: Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning.
rows.quest:8969:details:1: ⟦E36⟧ was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:8969:details:2: But even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.
rows.quest:8969:progress:0: I commend you, ⟦20⟧, if you have returned with the left piece of the amulet. If not, however, please take care of that as there is no time to waste, I assure you!
rows.quest:8969:completion:0: Good work, ⟦21⟧! ⟦E36⟧ wasn't all that bad for an ogre, at least not while he was still alive, so I hope he gets the rest that he deserves. But, there is more work ahead of us.
rows.quest:8969:completion:1: Unfortunately, I do not know the location of the one who died with the right piece of the amulet in their possession. But do not fear; in life I was a dabbler in the art of divination, so I have another task for you, which is going to enable us to ferret out the final piece.
rows.quest:8992:obj:0: Use the ⟦E35⟧ to summon forth the spirit of ⟦E36⟧ and slay him. ⟦E37⟧ inside ⟦E38⟧ with the recombined ⟦E41⟧ and the ⟦E35⟧.
rows.quest:8992:details:0: Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning next.
rows.quest:8992:details:1: ⟦E36⟧ was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:8992:details:2: But even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.
rows.quest:8992:progress:0: I commend you, ⟦22⟧, if you have returned with the completed amulet. If not, however, please take care of that as there is no time to waste, I assure you!
rows.quest:8992:completion:0: Good work, ⟦23⟧! ⟦E36⟧ wasn't all that bad for an ogre, at least not while he was still alive, so I hope he gets the rest that he deserves. And now we have the completed amulet! But we still have the hardest test ahead of us.
rows.quest:8992:completion:1: In order for the brazier to be attuned to calling forth ⟦E42⟧, there are a few more items that need to be gathered and brought back to me here.
